359:t_10:25.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
(That's right. A child dying before their parent is the worst unfilial thing there is.)

359:t_10:32.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「I'm sorry, $$シュシュ$$... I made you worry.」

359:t_10:36.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The start of that feud with $$ミカゲ$$ is connected to $$ミコノ$$'s past life...」

359:t_10:37.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Her love for $$アマタ$$, and blaming herself... If she stays caught between those conflicting feelings, she might end up like $n...」

359:t_10:38.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So you understood it too, Miss $$スズネ$$ - what $n's being the quiet type really means.」

359:t_10:40.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If $n had sunk completely into despair, his mind would have been destroyed...」

359:t_10:41.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If only hope had run ahead of him, he could have lived more carefree and cheerful... But that would mean forgetting his family's deaths.」

359:t_10:42.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n never fell into despair, and never clung to convenient hope either. He just kept living...」

359:t_10:43.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A razor-thin balance between hope and despair... I suppose that's what that 'quiet type' thing is.」

359:t_10:44.en:
$$スズネ$$
「But $n is trying to get past that.」

359:t_10:45.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Stop being the quiet type, hm... I wonder what awaits beyond that...」

359:t_10:46.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Seeing it through is my job.」

359:t_10:47.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Understood. Now then, to celebrate that future...」

359:t_10:49.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Impressive as ever! You know me so well!」

359:t_10:50.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Feel free to praise me even more.」

359:t_10:53.en:
$n
「...I've thought so for a while, but Miss $$スズネ$$ and AG have kind of the same vibe.」

359:t_10:55.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Um... When you get angry about that, it hurts my feelings too, you know...」

360:t_000:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「Confirmed: the approaching force is $$ネオ・ジオン$$!」

360:t_000:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「Covering for $$サイデリアル$$'s failure without missing a beat... That's quite a show of loyalty.」

360:t_000:2.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We can't just hand over the base we went to such trouble to take. We'll intercept them!」

360:t_001:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Launch every unit that's ready! Hurry!」

360:t_002:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「$c... I finally hear news of you after all this time, and I never thought you'd be in a place like this.」

360:t_002:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That purple unit...! Is that Captain $$アンジェロ$$?!」

360:t_002:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Be careful, $$バナージ$$! I'm feeling an ugly pressure from that unit!」

360:t_002:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「A machine that emits its pilot's aura, huh.」

360:t_002:4.en:
$$クェス$$
「Look, Colonel! $$ギュネイ$$'s here too!」

360:t_002:5.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$...! So you ended up joining $c after all!」

360:t_002:6.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Don't forget, $$ギュネイ$$. I'm the commander of this squad.」

360:t_002:8.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「With this $$ローゼン・ズール$$ the Colonel gave me, even a $$ガンダム$$...!」

360:t_002:9.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Lilin fighting Lilin... This world never changes, does it.」

360:t_002:10.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Did you sortie to see that?」

360:t_002:11.en:
$$カヲル$$
「That's not the only reason, though.」

360:t_002:13.en:
$$マリ$$
「Heeey, $$姫$$~. Our enemy is that $$ネオ・ジオン$$ over there, y'know.」

360:t_002:14.en:
$$アスカ$$
「...If I take down that EVA here, $$ＮＥＲＶ$$'s plan will be completely crushed...」

360:t_002:15.en:
$$アスカ$$
「That would be better for him, too...」

360:t_002:16.en:
$$マリ$$
「Aw, man... She's not gonna listen, huh...」

360:t_002:21.en:
$$アムロ$$
「When $$アクシズ$$ was falling, people's hearts became one, across the divide between Earth and space...」

360:t_002:23.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But reality didn't change. And look - people are still fighting.」

360:t_002:24.en:
$$シャア$$
「Even so, we have no intention of despairing. We believe that someday, people will get beyond that and move forward.」

360:t_002:25.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You're one of $c too. Don't give up.」

360:t_002:28.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, intercept $$ネオ・ジオン$$! We don't know the enemy's strength, so don't let your guard down against reinforcements!」

360:t_002:29.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Target the purple enemy commander unit!」

360:t_002:30.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Commence the attack! Remember that handing over the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ means losing hope!」

360:t_002:31.en:
$$シンジ$$
(Hope... There's nothing left for me now...)

360:t_003:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「Confirmed: a detached $$ネオ・ジオン$$ force is approaching!」

360:t_004:0.en:
$$レズン$$
「Got you, $c! We're making that spaceship $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s!」

360:t_004:1.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「This is bad! We can't cover everything like this!」

360:t_004:2.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「If only we could at least get the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$'s defense system running...!」

360:t_006:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The $$ガランシェール$$! Is that Captain $$ジンネマン$$?!」

360:t_006:2.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「You're safe, $$マリーダ$$. What a relief.」

360:t_006:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「Thank you for coming, $$ジンネマン$$.」

360:t_006:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Colonel, did you call the Captain here?」

360:t_006:5.en:
$$シャア$$
「Yes. We'll have them stay on as the staff of the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$, just as they are.」

360:t_006:6.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「$$ギルボア$$! Leave this to the $$ガランシェール$$, and you all go hit the enemies around here!」
